name: general
label: General (any topic)
description: No niche rules: stock searches use the narration's own key words.

stock._comment: B-roll hints: first matching line wins. Left side = words separated by | (whole-word match, case-insensitive).
stock._sources: Stock providers in the order tried: pixabay, pexels, unsplash (photos), wikimedia_video, archive (public-domain films).

llmGuidance: General faceless documentary / explainer video. Choose literal, searchable stock phrases for what the narration describes (places, objects, actions, eras).

qa._comment: Share of running time that may be still images/cards (product photos move with zoom/pan, but too many feel like a slideshow).
